Wingless.name: Equal-cardinality nibble checksum versus signed popcount collision geometry
Wingless.fixed_encoding: For each 4-bit raw nibble, code=(b0+2*b1+3*b2+4*b3)%5; channel=0.5*(code-2). Exactly five possible values per channel, same as prior signed popcount. 4 channels; 3 states per node. Same original 4-channel uniform anchor, w4/5/6 head. No new trained params.
Wingless.capacity: no increase in number of channel values, channels, node states or projection dimensions

Yggdrasil.name: Centered candidate-relative causal evidence rather than global accumulating drift
Yggdrasil.fixed_mechanism: At each hop enumerate the same active+retained edge candidates as F124-U, calculate prospective look public keys, subtract arithmetic mean look across current hop's candidates. Add 0.15*(delta0+delta1)*(look-mean)/depth to each candidate's accumulated value; clamp per-hop contribution to [-0.1,+0.1]. Original hard top7/retained9 selection and full base head unchanged.
Yggdrasil.capacity: exact 7 active 9 retained; no new cells/parameters, but operation cost counted and measured
